criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Official workflow accepts product images and product information and exposes reference/first/end-frame controls; exact ASIN identity across video is untested.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: No saved AIVP output or independent artifact-backed benchmark.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: First/end-frame, model choice, editing and reference-video analysis are documented; repeatability is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Official pages document trend discovery, analysis, product generation, editing and TikTok API publishing in one commerce workflow.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No controlled queue, render-time or failure-rate evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Plan prices and rough output estimates are published, but no free video allowance or measured cost per accepted output is established.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Official product page claims watermark-free commercial use; complete provider, music, avatar and reference-output terms require confirmation.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: First-party CLI, API-key workflow and installable agent skills are documented; security and runtime quality remain separate deployment gates.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Browser/API commerce workflow fits indie sellers; Australia-specific billing and TikTok Shop availability are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: High-intent topic, but no verified affiliate programme or AIVP tracking.

analysis: Strong documented ecommerce workflow and automation path, but no hands-on output evidence, free test allowance or complete rights chain.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor pages and first-party repository only; no controlled AIVP run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Not approved until exact LED-mask identity is distinctive in the first 10 seconds in all three runs.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; complete output/media rights unresolved.
hard_gates.integration: CLI must pass code audit, npm audit, sandbox, egress and cost-gate review before API-key use.
